text:
priya: Heads-up — deploybot aborted a staging publish to eu-west-1 because provenance metadata was missing a build_id. Can someone take a quick look?

deploy-bot: publish aborted: provenance.guard failed -> missing field: build_id. image=redwood/app-service:staging-2026-03-20, digest=sha256:abcd1234...

tyler: ah ok. Is that from the new buildkite step that injects buildmeta?

maya: I saw transient failures yesterday where our builder skipped metadata writes on retries. Might be related.

priya: The release window for this canary is 11:00-13:00 UTC. If we can't republish before 12:30, we should pin to previous digest and proceed with canary.

deploy-bot: note: deploybot will not promote images lacking provenance when promotion_policy=require_provenance=true.

tyler: I can try a manual republish with the same manifest + injected metadata. Quick command I used: `aws ecr put-image --repository-name redwood/app-service --image-tag staging-2026-03-20 --image-manifest file://manifest.json` (with buildmeta baked into manifest annotations).

maya: If you republish, make sure cosign attestation is present. Last time the attestation was uploaded to the wrong bucket and promo failed later.

priya: release-mgr: what's our rollback / pin decision? We want to avoid a second build if possible.

release-mgr: Prefer pinning to previous digest for the canary and queue republish for after the window. We can't risk delaying other teams. Can someone confirm prev digest?

tyler: prev digest for staging canary is sha256:9876fedc... — I can open a pin PR and update the release notes.

ops-oncall: tagging note: if you pin we'd still want an audit entry noting the temporary pin and reason (provenance missing). I can add that to the release channel.

priya: Good. Tyler, please add the pin PR + brief in release notes: "Temporary pin to previous digest due to missing build_id in provenance; republish scheduled." Include ETA for republish.

tyler: Will do. Also running `cosign verify-attestation --attestation-file=att.json` locally showed missing predicateType for build_id — looks like a generator issue.

maya: I'll triage the builder step that emits provenance. If it's a retry path skipping metadata, we'll patch today and schedule a re-run for the image.

deploy-bot: advisory: any promote attempt while manifest annotations differ from expected will be rejected by promote-checker.

release-mgr: Decision: pin to sha256:9876fedc... for canary/promote. Republish attempt with corrected metadata scheduled at 13:45 UTC. If republish succeeds and attestation verifies, we'll opt to retag and roll forward during next change window.

priya: Thanks team. Tyler — once PR is open ping #release-notes and I'll approve.

tyler: PR opened -> https://git.internal/r/redwood/releases/pull/458 (description + pin + rollback guidance). Adding release notes blurb now. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: I've logged the incident: INC-2026-0423 — publish aborted due to missing provenance build_id. Linked PR and scheduled republish.

maya: quick followup — I'm patching the generator to always emit `build_id` even on retry, plus unit-test. Will push in the next 30m.

priya: Sounds good. If republish still fails, we'll revert to doing a fresh build and coordinate a brief hold on canary.

deploy-bot: background: for reference, check the enforcement rule: `provenance.require_build_id=true` in promote-config. This is why abort happened.

tyler: copying the minimal commands for manual republish if needed:
```
# prepare manifest with annotations
jq '.annotations["build_id"]="bk-12345" | .annotations["builder"]="buildkite"' manifest.raw > manifest.json
aws ecr put-image --repository-name redwood/app-service --image-manifest file://manifest.json --image-tag staging-2026-03-20
cosign attach-attestation --predicate-file att.json --image $REPO:staging-2026-03-20
```
priya: Great. Closing the thread once PR + incident note are visible. Thanks everyone.

ops-oncall: incident updated with root cause and RCA owner (maya).
